scope: Actual URP SingleCameraRequest with main directional light, production MaskRBRFeature/MaskRBR shaders, scalar receiver HG/cone and radial CPU oracles, visible and fully occluded opaque geometry in a disposable preview scene, cloned renderer and pipeline. Existing scene feature order, XR and performance are outside this fixture.
graphBudget: Not measured: URP suppresses RenderGraph debug data during render requests; compiled graph budget needs a normal camera-frame capture.
pngDisplayMapping: Optional full 640x360 PNG: linear HDR RGB uses c/(1+c), then linear-to-sRGB; numeric assertions use linear RGBAFloat readback.

cases.name: Control.NonuniformSceneAlpha
cases.contract: Float baseline contains fractional background alpha and opaque geometry alpha

cases.name: Skip.IntensityZero
cases.contract: Zero effect intensity preserves real pipeline RGBA

cases.name: Skip.LengthZero
cases.contract: Off debug and zero length preserve real pipeline RGBA

cases.name: Mask.VisibleOpaqueAndOcclusion
cases.contract: Selected visible geometry enters the mask; unselected blue occluder and fully hidden selected object do not

cases.name: Mask.SkyDepth
cases.contract: Far-plane clear background enters sky mask while solid foreground is excluded

cases.name: Mask.UnionAndAlpha
cases.contract: Combined mask is the actual sky/object union and preserves original scene alpha

cases.name: Rays.Quality0
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits bounded grayscale scalar rays beyond the selected silhouette

cases.name: Rays.Quality1
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits bounded grayscale scalar rays beyond the selected silhouette

cases.name: Rays.Quality2
cases.contract: Actual fixed quality variant emits bounded grayscale scalar rays beyond the selected silhouette

cases.name: Rays.OffCenterDirectionOracle
cases.contract: Independent Camera viewport direction, bilinear mask taps and HG/cone predict actual off-center main-light scalar rays

cases.name: MainLight.DirectionAndLinearBinding
cases.contract: URP binds the real directional light toward the selected object, with real active-space color and intensity

cases.name: Composite.MainLightHDRAndAlpha
cases.contract: Production graph adds scalar rays times actual white main-light intensity and effect strength, retaining original alpha

cases.name: Rays.LightColorIndependent
cases.contract: Changing real directional-light RGB does not color or alter the scalar ray texture

cases.name: Composite.LinearMainLightColor
cases.contract: Each emitted RGB channel inherits URP linear main-light color rather than scene RGB or white clipping

cases.name: Rays.LightIntensityIndependent
cases.contract: Doubling the real main-light intensity leaves its scalar angular/radial coverage unchanged

cases.name: Composite.LightIntensityLinear
cases.contract: Doubling real main-light intensity doubles RGB emission above baseline

cases.name: Composite.EffectIntensityLinear
cases.contract: Halving effect strength cancels doubled main-light intensity and preserves every original alpha

cases.name: Rays.SceneRGBIndependent
cases.contract: Changing selected material, occluder material and background HDR RGB does not alter scalar rays

cases.name: Phase.IsotropicZeroLength
cases.contract: Zero-length debug still applies phase; g=0 and a full angular window retain one-tap union mask with peak one

cases.name: Phase.OffCenterHGAndConeOracle
cases.contract: Independent camera rays and peak-normalized HG/cone predict zero-length actual receiver emission and view/light sign

cases.name: Phase.AngularConcentration
cases.contract: Receiver emission decreases at increasing angular separation while off-center source peak remains near one

cases.name: Phase.G95NarrowConeOracle
cases.contract: Upper anisotropy endpoint remains finite and bounded, with peak one and exact zero outside a narrow angular window

cases.name: Phase.ExactWindowAndG95Concentration
cases.contract: Selected pixels outside the angle window emit zero; upper g concentrates energy while retaining a nonzero source peak

cases.name: Phase.LowUpsampleWindow
cases.contract: Low radial texture is upsampled before final-resolution angular emission; receiver pixels outside the cone stay zero

cases.name: MainLight.Absent
cases.contract: Absent real main light emits no scalar rays

cases.name: Debug.MaskWithoutMainLight
cases.contract: Mask inspection remains available when no directional main light exists

cases.name: MainLight.Behind
cases.contract: Behind-camera real main directional light emits no scalar rays

cases.name: MainLight.Orthographic
cases.contract: Orthographic camera has no finite directional radial focus and emits no rays

cases.name: Jitter.StableAcrossRequests
cases.contract: Spatial hash jitter remains identical across successive real camera requests

cases.name: Control.JitterChangesTaps
cases.contract: Nonzero spatial jitter changes actual boundary ray samples

cases.name: Rays.RenderScaleEndpoint0.1
cases.contract: Render-scale endpoint retains finite grayscale rays and binds length to final request dimensions rather than intermediate size

cases.name: Rays.RenderScaleEndpoint2.0
cases.contract: Render-scale endpoint retains finite grayscale rays and binds length to final request dimensions rather than intermediate size
